jobs.title: Faculty Support and Academic Program Coordinator, Office of Faculty Support and Academic Success Program
jobs.description:
Founded in 1896, the Gould School of Law has a distinguished past built on the principles of equity and excellence, and the courage to break new ground. USC first introduced legal education in Southern California. Today, the Law School continues to make history through its philosophy of innovation and through its people. USC Gould cultivates analytical ability, ethical values, and a spirit of collegiality that prepare students for meaningful careers benefiting society. It was one of the first law schools to engage students in clinical programs and remains a leader in experiential education.

The Gould School of Law is seeking to hire a Faculty Support Coordinator to join the Office of Faculty Support and support the Academic Success Program. This position will report to the Director of Faculty Support, and will assist a number of faculty with their research and teaching needs. The number of faculty assigned may vary throughout the year

**ATTENTION:** This position is full-time, benefits-eligible, and 1-year fixed term. Applicants must upload a cover letter and a resume to be considered for this position.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Preferred Education: Bachelor's degree in legal studies
* Preferred Experience: Experience in higher education

**Job Accountabilities:**

  

This position involves a variety of administrative tasks that include, but are not limited to, the following:

**50% Faculty Support**

  

* Directly completes work assignments from professors, including scanning and making photocopies, drafting and formatting letters of recommendation for students, proofreading and editing documents, ordering supplies, answering incoming calls and emails, managing and coordinating schedules.
* Helps prepare course materials, coordinates exams, takes class attendance, assists in the ordering of textbooks and additional resources, organizes and edits PowerPoint presentations, spreadsheets, and classroom handouts.
* Posts assignments, announcements, and readings to Brightspace, records grades, releases class recordings, and oversees other relevant course content.
* Arranges travel and parking reservations for faculty and guest speakers.
* Processes reimbursement requests for faculty travel and other university expenses.
* Sorts and sends mail, letters, and packages.
* Assists in event planning, including reserving meeting spaces, ordering catering, setting up rooms, coordinating speaking engagements for law professors, and other logistical needs.
* Lends classroom support to faculty to ensure that they know how to operate audio-visual equipment. Helps troubleshoot any IT issues.
* Files and/or transcribes legal documents.
* Will assist with both final exam administration and proctoring at the end of the Fall and Spring semesters and commencement each year.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**50% Academic Success Program (ASP):**

Gould’s ASP is a comprehensive program that assists JD students from admission to law school through admission to the bar. This means that ASP has programming, communications, events, and services on a 12-month schedule. The ASP is staffed by its director and associate director (both of whom are Gould faculty members), six ASP Fellows (who are upper division law students), and two Alumni Bar Coaches (who are recent Gould graduates). The program looks forward to welcoming a dedicated Faculty Support Coordinator to help with many tasks, including but not limited to those listed below. There will be other duties related to the program that are assigned or requested on an ad hoc basis and as the program changes.

The ASP Support Coordinator will also work with the faculty to create systems to make all of the ASP administrative tasks more routine and efficient, including developing ASP calendaring systems, tracking student communications, and creating instructions for how to complete required administrative tasks.

The ASP Support Coordinator will deal with students and with sensitive student data (including GPA data). As such, the ASP Support Coordinator must be highly respectful of confidentiality and privacy concerns.

It will be important for the ASP Support Coordinator to be present, on-campus dependably on at least three days per week, and on other days as needed. For example, the ASP Support Coordinator will be expected to be on campus on ASP workshop days, and during summer programs including the simulated bar exam (early July), Gould Preview (early-to-mid August), and Orientation (mid-August).

The administrative responsibilities of the ASP Support Coordinator include both those listed above under Faculty Support and the following, which is a non-exhaustive list:

  

* Creating, updating, and disseminating flyers and other publicity to promote ASP events
* Scheduling rooms and communications with other departments (often having to reschedule rooms at last minute because of double-booked events)
* Ordering and delivering food for ASP events and workshops
* Creating and administering surveys for a variety of purposes including surveys to evaluate the ASP’s events, workshops, courses, and other programs
* Updating content and posting announcements on the ASP Brightspace page
* Coordinating with ASP Fellows, alumni bar coaches, and student and alumni volunteers on events, workshops, and projects
* Outreach to other faculty to coordinate teaching schedules, reading assignments, etc. for Gould Preview and other ASP programs
* Organizing and distributing materials (e.g., homework and readings) to students through

* Communicating with students and prospective students by email and in person, including responding to routine questions from students and alumni
* Working with Gould’s Events team on ASP events and workshops
* Updating regular and ongoing monthly (and during spring and summer, weekly) email communications for students and recent graduates

**POSITION TITLE:** PR and Marketing Coordinator  
**REPORTING TO:** Director of Advancement

Non-Exempt

**GENERAL SUMMARY:** The job of PR and Marketing Coordinator was established to coordinate OCCA's marketing, digital communications, and assist with fundraising and donor relations. The Coordinator develops accurate and compelling content that increases awareness of OCCA, strengthens engagement with current and prospective families, supports enrollment and advancement priorities, and consistently reflects the school's mission and classical identity.

This position is distinguished by its schoolwide scope and its combination of creative production, relationship-building, and detailed project management. The Coordinator works across the Lower School and Upper School to gather stories, manage communications channels, protect student privacy, and translate OCCA's mission into clear messaging for families, community partners, donors, media, and the broader public. The incumbent is expected to manage routine work independently, collaborate closely with the Director of Advancement, and exercise sound judgment in a fast-paced school environment.

* Draft press releases, media advisories, background materials, official statements, and other public-relations materials for leadership review and approval.
* Develop relationships with community organizations, civic partners, and local media that increase understanding of OCCA and its contribution to Orange County families.

* Use the donor CRM for routine data entry, tracking, list preparation, and basic reporting while maintaining accurate and confidential records.

jobs.title: Trade Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Salary Range:** **$26.00 - $28.00/ Hourly**

SUMMARY: This role provides coordination and administrative support to the trade marketing team, serving as the central coordinator for all trade marketing plans managed by Marketing. Positioned between the marketing and sales functions, the Trade Marketing Coordinator manages trade plan requests in Asana, tracks and reconciles invoices against approved plans, and ensures marketing collateral and deliverables reach the sales team on time. Working closely with marketing and sales team members, this role helps integrate trade and direct marketing plans so both teams stay aligned, informed, and on schedule.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Serve as the coordinator for all trade marketing plans managed by the Marketing team, maintaining plan details, timelines, budgets, and deliverables in a central, up-to-date view.
* Support incoming Asana requests related to trade plans, helping confirm briefs are complete, due dates are clear, and tasks reach the appropriate team members.
* Track and compare trade partner and vendor invoices against approved trade plans, flagging discrepancies, overages, or undelivered items and following up with stakeholders to resolve them.
* Ensure marketing collateral and deliverables are shared with the sales team on time, coordinating deadlines and communicating updates or changes as they arise.
* Support the integration of trade and direct marketing plans, helping align timing, offers, and messaging across channels so the two plans work together.
* Review trade and sales-facing marketing materials, including approach guides, the travel advisor portal, and sales and consortia materials, flagging outdated, inaccurate, or off-brand content for the appropriate owners and making minor corrections where appropriate.
* Act as a day-to-day liaison between Marketing and Sales on trade plan status, questions, and requested updates, tracking them through to completion.
* Support trade shows, sales events, and partner programs as needed, including logistics, materials, vendor communication, and attendee coordination.
* Prepare status reports, trackers, and meeting notes to provide visibility into trade plan progress, planned versus actual spend, and team priorities.
* Maintain project documentation, workflows, templates, and process guides to support consistent trade plan management across Marketing and Sales.
* Provide general administrative support to the Marketing team as needed.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by management.

COMPETENCIES: To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the

following competencies:

* Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; Uses time efficiently; Plans for additional resources; Sets goals and objectives; Organizes or schedules other people and their tasks; Develops realistic action plans.
* Quality Management - Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness.
* Dependability - Follows instructions, responds to management direction; Takes responsibility for own actions; Keeps commitments; Commits to long hours of work when necessary to reach goals; Completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan.
* Project Management - Develops project plans; Coordinates projects; Communicates changes and progress; Completes projects on time and budget; Manages project team activities.
* Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.
* Cost Consciousness - Works within approved budget; Develops and implements cost saving measures; Contributes to profits and revenue; Conserves organizational resources.
* Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that

must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform

essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to walk, stoop,

kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee is frequently required to stand, reach with hands and arms. The employee is continually required to sit, use hands to finger, handle or feel; talk or hear.

The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 45 pounds.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and color vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are

representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this

job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform

the essential functions.

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

The ideal candidate combines strong sales abilities with practical fabrication knowledge, creative problem-solving, and technical estimating experience.

Our expectation is that you will become increasingly independent in managing sales opportunities and developing complete, accurate proposals.

* Develop preliminary layouts, dimensions, material selections, and finishes.

* Prepare professional presentations that clearly communicate proposed designs and functionality.

* Identify appropriate materials and construction methods based on project requirements.

jobs.description:

===========

The Logistics Coordinator II serves as a key liaison between customers, carriers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure the successful execution of international and domestic shipments. This position requires strong account management skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple shipments and client relationships simultaneously.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

jobs.title: Executive Assistant (CSO & CMO)
jobs.description:
Pressed Juicery is growing! Join our purpose-driven community and help us make an impact.
  
  
About Pressed Juicery
  
  
Pressed Juicery is a modern wellness brand built with the mission to empower your wellness journey.
  
  
Founded in 2010 by three friends, Pressed began as a small space with a big idea: real, nourishing food should be accessible and fit into everyday life. What started in a tiny Los Angeles juice bar has grown into a dynamic omnichannel brand, with products available through thousands of retailers nationwide, alongside our company-owned stores and direct-to-consumer channel.
  
  
At Pressed Juicery, we operate as one community bringing high-quality, better-for-you products to market. Guided by passion and purpose, we’re building what’s next in wellness.
  
  
Our Mission
  
  
Pressed Juicery’s mission is to empower your wellness journey.
  
  
Our Workplace Culture
  
  

* We embrace diversity, equity, inclusion, and belongingness!
* We speak up with radically candid communication.
* We wholeheartedly support personal and professional growth.
* We believe mistakes can be valuable and lead to continuous improvement.
* Lastly, we value excellence and strive to achieve greatness in all we do!

Our Values
  
  

* Community - as leaders, we celebrate differences, champion strengths, and compassionately aspire to be our most vibrant selves.
* Passion - curious and humble, we inspire people to make healthy choices.
* Growth - pursuing wellness with intention, we create and embrace good energy.

Our Benefits
  
  

* Medical, dental, and vision
* 401(k) - match up to 4% of compensation
* Awesome paid time-off and holidays
* Flexible Spending Account
* Generous paid parental leave
* Annual performance and compensation reviews
* Focus on career-pathing and promotions
* Professional and leadership development workshops
* Free Pressed products!

About the Role
  
The Executive Assistant reports to the Chief Sales Officer (CSO) and provides dedicated support to both the CSO and the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO). The role owns calendar management, travel, expenses, executive presentations, and the coordination of leadership and company-wide meetings, freeing both executives to focus on growing Pressed. Pressed is an ever-changing, evolving organization, and this role will evolve with it!
  
  
**Note:** this position is hybrid, working Monday-Thursday in our Culver City office.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Executive Support & Administration
  

* Manage and prioritize complex calendars for our CSO (Chief Sales Officer), CMO (Chief Marketing Officer) and SVP Sales, including scheduling, rescheduling, and protecting focus time.
* Plan and coordinate domestic and international travel, including itineraries, accommodations, and meeting logistics.
* Track and prepare expense reports, reconcile credit card statements, and assist with budget management for Sales & Marketing.
* Draft, proof, and edit correspondence, presentations, and internal/external communications.
* Expertise in Outlook and Monday.com is a plus.

Meeting & Project Coordination
  

* Prepare meeting agendas, materials, and presentations in advance, ensuring executives are fully briefed.
* Help keep meetings on track and on time.
* Devise process to capture meeting notes, track action items, and follow up to ensure timely completion.
* Organize and coordinate leadership offsites, sales meetings, marketing launch events, and team-building activities.
* Responsible for working with 3rd party companies and vendors to ensure seamless execution of meetings.
* Support cross-functional initiatives and projects that require coordination between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product Development, and Finance.

Operational Efficiency
  

* Maintain systems for tracking key projects, deadlines, and deliverables.
* Anticipate operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Serve as liaison for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring timely communication and follow-up.
* Partner with Sales & Marketing leadership to streamline workflows and improve team productivity.

Confidentiality & Discretion
  

* Handle sensitive company, personnel, and strategic information with absolute confidentiality.
* Exercise sound judgment in managing competing priorities and confidential matters.

Qualifications
  

* 5+ years' experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C-level executives; CPG food & beverage or wellness experience (and a passion for health and wellness) a plus.
* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook; experience with Teams, Slack, and Smartsheet preferred.
* Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to work faster and smarter, plus the ability to quickly adopt new software.
* Excels in evolving, changing situations and handles each with flexibility and positivity.
* Proven ability to support multiple executives and manage competing priorities with discretion and without dropping details.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with extraordinary attention to detail and responsiveness.
* Flexibility for occasional travel to offsites and sales meetings, and for time-sensitive needs outside standard hours.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without restriction.

Apply now to start your wellness journey at Pressed!

Your ambition has a home here.

The Assistant Account Manager provides a high level of support in obtaining, maintaining, expanding, and servicing commercial lines accounts. * High School / GED
* 1-2 years insurance industry experience or equivalent combination of education & experience
* Property & Causality License required within first 6 months
* Experience in Medical Malpractice Insurance a plus

* Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages.

* Ability to efficiently gather pertinent information and facts, analyze and solve problems timely and thoroughly.
* Ability to prioritize and organize multiple tasks and responsibilities in order to complete assignments on time and with optimal accuracy.

* Computer skills: proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Outlook.
* Critical Thinking: Ability to use logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.
* Desire to learn and grow within the insurance industry.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* This position primarily involves remaining in a stationary position for the majority of the workday.
* The person in this position frequently communicates with colleagues and clients both in person and on the telephone; Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information.

jobs.title: Channel Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  
The Channel Marketing Specialist supports the development and execution of B2B channel marketing programs designed to increase partner engagement, product awareness, customer demand, and sales opportunities.

This role works closely with Channel Marketing, Channel Sales, Product Marketing, Creative, Digital Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to coordinate partner campaigns, communications, product launches, events, and sales enablement activities.

The position is designed for an early-career marketing professional who is interested in developing experience in B2B technology and channel marketing. The Channel Marketing Specialist will assist with day-to-day program execution, content coordination, partner communications, campaign tracking, and other marketing activities that support TP-Link's distributors, resellers, integrators, service providers, and other channel partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Channel Marketing & Campaign Support**

* Support the development and execution of B2B channel marketing campaigns and programs.
* Assist with partner-facing campaigns supporting product launches, promotions, customer acquisition, and other business priorities.
* Coordinate campaign timelines, deliverables, marketing materials, and internal approvals.
* Help prepare campaign briefs, project trackers, calendars, and other materials supporting campaign execution.
* Coordinate with Creative, Digital Marketing, Product Marketing, and other teams to support the development and delivery of campaign assets.
* Monitor campaign activities and assist with collecting and organizing performance results.
* Support ongoing efforts to improve partner participation and campaign effectiveness.

**Partner Communications & Enablement**

* Support communications with distributors, resellers, integrators, service providers, and other B2B channel partners.
* Assist with the development and distribution of partner newsletters, product announcements, promotional communications, and campaign materials.
* Coordinate updates to partner-facing sales and marketing materials, including sell sheets, product announcements, program guides, and presentations.
* Work with Product Marketing and Sales teams to ensure partners receive current product information, messaging, and marketing resources.
* Assist with partner training and enablement activities, including coordinating materials, communications, and logistics.
* Help maintain organized and up-to-date partner marketing resources.

**Product Launch & Go-to-Market Support**

* Support channel marketing activities associated with new product and solution launches.
* Coordinate partner-facing launch communications, materials, and campaign deliverables.
* Work with Product Marketing to translate product positioning and messaging into channel-ready materials.
* Assist Channel Sales with the resources and communications needed to support partner activation.
* Track launch-related activities and help ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.
* Gather feedback from Sales and channel partners to help improve future programs and communications.

**Partner Programs, Events & Promotions**

* Support partner marketing programs, promotions, webinars, trade shows, and other channel activities.
* Assist with event planning and coordination, including communications, materials, schedules, and follow-up activities.
* Help coordinate marketing activities with distributors and other channel partners.
* Support the development of promotional materials and partner communications.
* Assist with tracking partner participation and engagement in programs, promotions, and events.
* Maintain documentation and project trackers for partner marketing activities.

**Cross-Functional Coordination & Performance Tracking**

* Collaborate with Channel Sales, Product Marketing, Creative, Digital Marketing, Sales Operations, and other internal teams to support channel initiatives.
* Assist with tracking campaign participation, engagement, leads, and other marketing performance metrics.
* Help prepare reports, presentations, and program updates for internal stakeholders.
* Maintain marketing calendars, project trackers, partner lists, and campaign records.
* Support lead follow-up coordination between Marketing and Sales teams.
* Gather feedback from Sales and partners to help identify opportunities to improve channel marketing programs.
* Support day-to-day administrative and project coordination needs for the Channel Marketing team.

**Role Expectations**

Success in this role requires strong organization, communication, attention to detail, and an interest in developing a career in B2B and channel marketing.

The Channel Marketing Specialist is expected to support the effective and timely execution of partner campaigns, communications, product launches, events, and enablement initiatives while working collaboratively across multiple teams.

The role requires the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines, communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, and learn TP-Link's products, partner ecosystem, and B2B marketing processes.

The Channel Marketing Specialist should be proactive, dependable, eager to learn, and comfortable working in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field preferred.
* 0–2 years of experience in marketing, channel marketing, digital marketing, sales support, communications, or a related field; relevant internships, academic projects, or equivalent experience may be considered.
* Interest in B2B technology, networking, channel marketing, or partner marketing.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and O

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator (AIR & Ocean Operations)
jobs.description:
**1. Position Overview**

The Mobile Business Unit supports the global distribution of Samsung mobile devices with a focus on speed, reliability, and operational efficiency. The Logistics Coordinator (Air & Ocean Operations) is responsible for planning, executing, and continuously improving inbound and outbound air and ocean freight operations, ensuring shipments move efficiently from manufacturers to Samsung warehouses and ultimately to customers.

This position requires hands-on experience in Air or Ocean Freight Operations, along with solid ocean freight knowledge. As our operation supports global transportation across multiple time zones, this position follows a five-day work schedule that includes weekend shifts based on operational requirements.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

1) Planning & Scheduling

* Create and maintain daily tracking reports for Air Export, Ocean Import and OTR including weekend operations

2) Port & Terminal Coordination

* Gather departure information for containers and air cargo at ports, terminals, and airports.
* Monitor and confirm on-time departures from U.S. Ocean terminals and major airports.
* Coordinate terminal departure schedules with terminal operators and customs brokers.

3) Movement Monitoring

* Track ocean containers, rail intermodal units, and air shipments in real time.
* Validate Import of Documentation (IOD) and Proof of Delivery (POD) on a daily basis.
* Respond promptly to shipment exceptions requiring immediate attention (e.g., delays, damages, customs hold).

4) Transload Warehouse Management

* Oversee Transload Warehouse (TW) capacity planning and utilization.
* Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for transload operations (e.g., dwell time, on-time transload, damage rate).
* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks and work with warehouse teams to implement corrective actions.

5) TL OB OTR Dispatch Management

* Schedule and dispatch Truckload (TL) Outbound (OB) orders using the Transportation Management System (TMS).
* Optimize routing and load consolidation to meet service-level agreements while minimizing transportation costs.

6) Partner & Stakeholder Communication

* Serve as the primary point of contact for logistics partners, including carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, internal supply chain teams, and customers.
* Handle claims, documentation, and issue escalations through phone, email, or virtual meetings.

7) Compliance & Documentation

* Ensure all shipments comply with international trade regulations, hazardous material requirements, and security standards.
* Maintain accurate records for audits and regulatory inspections.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

8) Core Competencies

* Analytical Thinking: Translate large data sets into actionable insights.
* Problem Solving: Quickly identify root causes of operational issues and implement effective solutions.
* Communication: Communicate clearly and effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* Multitasking: Manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to Work Under Pressure: Perform effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

**3. Requirements (Basic Qualifications)**

1) Education

* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

2) Experience

* Staff : Minimum 2 years of experience in logistics coordination, with a strong focus on international air and ocean freight operations.
* Senior :Minimum 6 years of experience in logistics coordination, with a strong focus on international air and ocean freight operations.
* Hands-on experience in international Air, Ocean, and OTR freight forwarding operations is required
* Proven experience managing transload warehouse operations and Truckload (TL) dispatch.

3) Industry Knowledge

* Strong understanding of international air and ocean freight regulations, and customs procedures

4) Technical Skills

* Proficiency with ERP and logistics systems (SAP, TMS, WMS or equivalent).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.

5) Language

* English

6) Weekend work may be required.

  
Pay Range: $22.00 to $38/hour

Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; paid sick leave; life, accidental death & dismemberment (AD&D), and long-term disability (LTD) insurance; and optional voluntary life/AD&D coverage. Benefits are subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms.

* Leading the overall administration, compliance, and maintenance of the property, while striving to maintain 100% occupancy.
* Must assume proactive behavior and measures to properly represent Quality Management Group, Inc. and build relationships in the community.

The Assistant Community Manager reports to the Community Manager or Senior Community Manager.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Compliance**

* Ensure resident files and Yardi data are maintained in accordance with Compliance and Property Management policies and regulations.
* Review, process and approve all resident notices pertaining to recertification.
* Assist in maintaining property waiting list in accordance with the properties’ Tenant Selection Plan.
* Process applications for housing in accordance with properties’ affordable housing covenants.
* Assist in processing annual re-certifications within established timelines.

**Property Operations**

* Assist in marketing and advertising for vacancies in accordance with properties’ Affirmative Fair Housing Marketing Plan.
* Assist in ensuring that all appropriate notices are remitted to residents in a timely manner and are completed and served within the requirements set forth in the lease.
* Visually inspect grounds, buildings, and apartment units on a regular basis between annual inspections.
* Work cohesively with resident services staff to ensure vacancies turn times are met in accordance with company policy and that move-in dates are met.
* Work with the Community Manager to ensure work orders are processed in Yardi within established timelines.
* Assist in showing available units.
* Maintain general office and resident files.
* Take a proactive role in shopping the competition and marketing.
* Record traffic in software program daily.
* Follow up with Guest Cards or a “Thank-You” response within twenty-four (24) hours of the visit with the prospect
* Assist Community Manager with legal proceedings.

**Financial**

* Prepare deposits for banking and posts resident payments into Yardi within timelines established by management.
* Keeps resident ledgers accurate and works diligently with accounting to resolve any errors.
* Assist in preparing deposits for banking and making daily bank runs.
* Post resident payments into Yardi in a timely manner.
* Assist Community Manager in preparing management required month end reports.
* Assist in annual budget preparation

**Human Resources**

* Maintain positive relationships with internal departments.

**Customer Service**

* Respond to all resident complaints in a timely and professional manner.
* Assist residents always when requested.
* Create a community of caring and excitement that is contagious for our residents and noticeable to the community at large.

**General**

* Must attend Company sponsored events that relate to the development of the team, which, from time to time, may include travel and overnight stays at locations away from the employee’s home.
* This position may require the availability to work some nights, weekends and occasional holidays based upon the needs of the community.
* Demonstrate initiative, personal awareness, professionalism, integrity, and exercise confidentiality in all areas of performance.
* Other duties as requested.

**ESSENTIAL SKILLS:**

* Must have a strong work ethic and positive attitude.
* Ability to work with and understand persons of all ethnic and family backgrounds.
* Proficient in English language in verbal and written communications
* Relate to others beyond giving and receiving instructions
* Handle high stress situations effectively
* The ability to both prioritize and delegate as needed
* Computer literacy in Outlook, Word, Excel, and the Internet

**EXPERIENCE:**

* Minimum of a high school education or equivalent.
* Minimum one to three years working in a position with comparable responsibilities.
* Minimum one to two years working in a customer service environment.
* Knowledge in HUD and Tax Credit programs
* Basic math principles including the ability to work with a calculator
* Yardi property management accounting software is preferred.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* 5-7 hours of sitting, reading, and typing daily
* 1-3 hours of walking daily
* Operates Computer requiring the use of hands/fingers
* Occasional bending, reaching, kneeling and/or crouching
* Regular lifting of up to 30 pounds
* Occasional climbing of stairs
* Specific vision requirements include close vision, distance vision and color vision.
* Specific audio/verbal abilities include communication with residents, employees, vendors, and owners both in person and via telephone.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

Work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential function of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing this job, the employee is exposed to weather conditions prevalent at the time. This may include warm, hot, or cold temperatures. The noise level in the work environment is moderate.

jobs.title: Facilities Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**SALARY RANGE**

$82,000 to $87,000 Annually

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION**

The Facilities Project Coordinator supports the day-to-day operations of the Building Operations department through coordination of facilities requests, work orders, vendor activities, preventive maintenance workflows, and operational administration. The position serves as a central point of coordination and follow-through, helping ensure facilities activities are organized, tracked, communicated, and completed in a timely and consistent manner.

Working under the supervision of the Senior Project Manager, the Facilities Project Coordinator operates with initiative and appropriate autonomy to manage routine workflows, resolve issues within established procedures, and escalate matters requiring technical, budgetary, compliance, or leadership decisions.

This position supports strategic facility initiatives of the organization anticipated to occur over a two-year period. It is anticipated that employment in this position will continue through approximately fall 2028. The Facilities Project Coordinator role is an at-will position; length of employment will be determined based on project completion dates and schedules.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Work Order & Issue Management**

* Support the coordination of facilities requests alongside Facilities Operations team, ensuring each issue is logged, prioritized, assigned, communicated, and closed with documented follow-through.
* Administer the Angus work order system, including ticket review, assignment coordination, status tracking, reporting, user support, and workflow maintenance.
* Monitor open, overdue, recurring, and unresolved service requests; follow up proactively and escalate safety concerns, delays, or items requiring technical, budgetary, compliance, or leadership decisions.
* Assist the Facilities Operations Manager with scheduling vendors for planned maintenance, urgent service needs, and unplanned repairs.
* Coordinate work orders, vendor activity, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions through completion, confirming that required documentation and closeout information are recorded.
* Communicate service impacts, access needs, project updates, and work status to staff, vendors, and other stakeholders.

**Facility Inspections & Follow-Through**

* Coordinate quarterly facility walkthroughs with preschool site directors, document identified needs, submit work orders, and track completion.
* Coordinate quarterly inspections across all sites with Facilities and Program Support teams, document findings, open and assign work orders, and follow through on corrective actions.

**Tracking, Documentation & Administration**

* Maintain facilities project and request trackers by logging new requests, updating priorities and status, and monitoring work from initiation through completion.
* Maintain organized shared drives so project documentation, communications, vendor records, and closeout materials are current and easy to retrieve.
* Manage routine facilities administration, including vendor records, invoice routing, purchasing support, reporting, and recordkeeping.

**Project & Operational Support**

* Assist with facilities and IT project coordination tasks, including scheduling, documentation, access coordination, status tracking, and follow-up for project managers.
* Coordinate contractor access and support operational readiness activities related to scheduled facilities work.
* Provide coverage for the Facilities Operations Manager during absences to maintain continuity of routine facilities workflows and issue escalation.
* Support facilities, compliance, process-improvement, and special projects as assigned, including documentation and workflow updates.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Associate or bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Two or more years of experience in facilities coordination, workplace operations, office administration, property management, hospitality, or a similar operational support role.
* Experience coordinating maintenance requests, vendors, contractors, or service providers in a complex or high-volume environment.
* Experience using ticketing, work order, or maintenance management systems; Angus experience preferred.
* Highly meticulous with strong file management and record-keeping habits that hold up under a high volume of concurrent work.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, take initiative, prioritize competing demands, and follow work through completion with limited supervision.
* Ability to process information and communicate clearly and concisely.
* Strong organizational, administrative, communication, and customer Service skills.
* Experience supporting purchasing, invoicing, vendor administration, or operational recordkeeping.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Teams, SharePoint, and Lists.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**  
This position is primarily performed on-site at JCCSF facilities and includes work in office, program, storage, mechanical, and other operational spaces. Occasional remote work may be considered when appropriate for specific tasks and operational requirements.

The position requires regular movement throughout the facility and frequent interaction with staff, vendors, contractors, and members of the Building Operations team. The employee may occasionally encounter noise, dust, active maintenance work, mechanical equipment, and areas with varying temperatures.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**  
Duties include regular walking throughout the facility, standing, sitting, using stairs, accessing storage and operational areas, and performing physical tasks consistent with a facilities coordination position.

The employee must be able to lift and carry items weighing up to twenty pounds. Reasonable accommodation may be provided as appropriate.

**STATUS:** Benefited, non-exempt

**HOURS:** 40 hours per week

**SCHEDULE:** Monday - Friday, general business

jobs.title: Project Coordinator - Generator Services
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive **Project Coordinator** to support the planning, coordination, and execution of generator maintenance, repair, and installation projects.

This position plays a key role in keeping projects organized, monitoring progress, coordinating schedules, tracking materials, and ensuring timely communication among customers, vendors, project managers, and field technicians. Responsibilities include project tracking, scheduling, purchasing, inventory coordination, documentation, and administrative support throughout the project lifecycle.

The ideal candidate is a self-motivated problem solver who enjoys managing multiple projects, organizing complex information, following up on outstanding tasks, and helping projects move forward efficiently in a fast-paced technical service environment.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**  
**Project Coordination & Management**

* Coordinate and track multiple generator maintenance, repair, and installation projects from initiation through completion.
* Maintain project schedules, timelines, milestones, and task lists to ensure work progresses according to plan.
* Monitor project statuses, identify outstanding tasks, and proactively follow up with responsible team members.
* Coordinate with project managers, technicians, customers, and vendors to ensure project requirements and deadlines are met.
* Track project deliverables, material availability, scheduling requirements, and other dependencies that may affect progress.
* Identify potential delays, scheduling conflicts, and project bottlenecks, and communicate issues to management.
* Assist with project planning, resource allocation, and scheduling of field personnel.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date job information in company project management software.
* Provide regular project status updates and help prioritize work based on deadlines and operational needs.
* Assist with project closeout, ensuring required documentation, reporting, and administrative tasks are completed.

**Scheduling & Operations Coordination**

* Coordinate service appointments, field visits, inspections, deliveries, and project-related activities.
* Communicate with customers and field technicians regarding scheduling, site access, and project requirements.
* Track technician availability, equipment readiness, material deliveries, and other scheduling dependencies.
* Follow up on incomplete work, pending approvals, and outstanding customer or vendor responses.
* Assist with coordinating multiple projects while adjusting to changing priorities and urgent service requests.

**Purchasing & Inventory Management**

* Research replacement parts, equipment, and materials required for service and installation projects.
* Obtain vendor quotations, compare pricing and availability, and assist with purchasing decisions.
* Prepare purchase orders and track order confirmations, shipments, and expected delivery dates.
* Coordinate material deliveries to the office, warehouse, or project sites.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and assist with stock replenishment.
* Monitor parts availability and proactively identify material shortages that could delay projects.
* Coordinate returns, exchanges, warranty claims, and special orders as needed.

**Project Documentation & Reporting**

* Prepare and organize service reports, repair proposals, inspection documents, and project-related correspondence.
* Maintain accurate equipment maintenance histories, customer records, and project documentation.
* Organize technical manuals, photographs, drawings, warranties, and other supporting materials.
* Maintain project tracking spreadsheets, databases, and internal reporting systems.
* Assist with tracking project costs, purchase orders, and other financial information.
* Prepare project status summaries and progress reports for internal review.
* Assist with invoice preparation, project closeout documentation, and verification of completed work.

**Customer & Vendor Communication**

* Serve as a point of contact for project-related scheduling, status updates, and routine inquiries.
* Communicate professionally with customers, suppliers, subcontractors, and field personnel.
* Follow up with vendors regarding quotations, pricing, availability, shipping, warranties, and lead times.
* Coordinate customer approvals, scheduling confirmations, and required project information.
* Help resolve routine coordination issues and escalate technical or operational concerns when necessary.
* Ensure timely communication and follow-through on outstanding requests and commitments.

**Administrative & Compliance Support**

* Maintain organized electronic project files, spreadsheets, and internal tracking systems.
* Assist with obtaining permits, scheduling inspections, and preparing compliance-related documentation.
* Support documentation requirements for commercial and public works projects.
* Help improve administrative workflows, project tracking processes, and internal communication.
* Perform other project coordination and administrative duties as assigned.

**Qualifications Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Excellent organizational, planning, and time management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, particularly spreadsheets.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and proactively follow up on outstanding tasks.
* Professional customer service skills and ability to communicate with different team members.
* Strong willingness to learn technical concepts, business processes, and project management software.

**Preferred**

* Previous work experience is not required.
* Experience in project coordination, operations, purchasing, inventory management, or administ

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

KIOXIA America, Inc. (formerly Toshiba Memory America, Inc.) is the US-based subsidiary of KIOXIA Corporation, a leading worldwide supplier of flash memory and solid state drives (SSDs). From the invention of flash memory to today’s breakthrough BiCS FLASH™ 3D technology, KIOXIA continues to pioneer cutting-edge memory solutions and services that enrich people's lives and expand society's horizons. The company's innovative 3D flash memory technology, BiCS FLASH™, is shaping the future of storage in high-density applications, including advanced smartphones, PCs, SSDs, automotive and data centers.

 **Job Description**

KIOXIA America Inc. is seeking a highly skilled Partner Alliance/Technical Ecosystem Project Manager Specialist to develop and grow our SSD business in the SSD ecosystem development segment. This individual directly reports into the SSD BU and requires a unique blend of strategic negotiation, technical, and marketing skills. Not only will you coordinate internally with many cross-functional teams to reach critical business decisions on ecosystem and technical support strategy, but you will work with world-class ecosystem leaders directly in the industry. The ecosystem scope includes hardware companies such as CPUs, PCIe related peripherals, etc. and software companies such as Operating Systems, Storage Drivers, Virtualization Software, Software-Defined Storage (SDS) and so on.

Our ideal candidate will leverage their technical background to drive and manage ecosystem strategy at both a tactical and strategic level while working closely with customers, sales, product and business development managers, technical marketing and support, business ops, and other cross-functional teams. This is a complex job that requires exceptional attention to detail, multi-tasking capabilities, and the ability to follow through on initiatives with many internal teams.

**Key activities include:** Roadmap alignment with ecosystem partners, SSD sample planning, SSD validation testing and developing execution strategies on joint marketing and collaboration activities. This position provides an excellent opportunity to participate in growing the SSD ecosystem industry including NVMe, SDS, and other new emerging markets such as AI/ML, block-chain and autonomous driving.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact (PoC) for KIOXIA’s ecosystem strategy, leading the development, expansion, and management of strategic partnerships with leading global technology companies
* Build and execute a scalable ecosystem strategy that aligns with KIOXIA’s product roadmap, market priorities, and revenue objectives
* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Technical Support teams to operationalize ecosystem initiatives, including:
  + Driving SSD sampling programs, AVL qualification, and interoperability (interop) testing with key ecosystem partners
  + Planning and executing joint workshops, plug-fests, and validation events to accelerate solution readiness and customer adoption
  + Aligning technology roadmaps and reference architectures with hyperscalers, OEMs, and platform partners
  + Supporting customer engagements with ecosystem-backed solutions and joint value propositions
* Lead ecosystem presence at industry forums and customer-facing events, ensuring strong technical and strategic positioning of KIOXIA solutions
* Act as a bridge between technical and commercial domains, enabling effective communication across engineering, business, and partner teams
* Identify, prioritize, and onboard new strategic partners to expand KIOXIA’s ecosystem footprint in AI, hyperscale, and enterprise markets
* Develop and track KPIs for ecosystem success, including design wins, qualifications, joint solutions, and revenue influence
* Drive go-to-market alignment with partners, including joint messaging, solution briefs, and co-marketing initiatives

  
**Qualifications**  

* 7+ years of experience in ecosystem development, partnerships, or program management within the semiconductor, storage, or broader data center technology industry
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field
* MBA or Master’s degree preferred
* Proven ability to manage complex cross-functional programs and influence without authority across global teams
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging both technical and executive audiences

**Technical & Domain Expertise**

* Solid understanding of:
  + Enterprise, Data Center, and Client SSD architectures (NVMe, PCIe Gen4/5/6, EDSFF form factors)
  + Storage systems and infrastructure (RAID, distributed storage, hyperscale architectures)
  + Software-defined storage, virtualization, and operating systems (Linux, Kubernetes, VMware, etc.
* Role may require cross-segment flexibility in the future, with the opportunity to rotate between Client (OEM/Notebook) and Hyperscale/Data Center SSD Product Management to build broad domain expertise and drive unified product strategy
* Familiarity with:
  + AI/ML infrastructure trends, including GPU-based systems, storage tiering, and data pipelines

  + Qualification processes (AVL), validation flows, and system-level integration challenges

jobs.title: Program Specialist II - Clean Water Program
jobs.description:
**Nature of Position**
----------------------

**THE POSITION**

The City of Alameda is seeking to fill a **Program Specialist II** position **to administer the City's Clean Water Program activities.** Under direction, Program Specialist II's perform a variety of detailed, specialized program work in public infrastructure management, community development, environmental compliance and/or other designated areas; and perform other related work as required. Positions assigned to this classification are expected to perform varied assignments requiring technical and interpersonal skill in assigned program areas. Work in the class is distinguished from that of the Program Specialist I by the greater complexity of the assignments received and by the greater independence with which the incumbent is expected to operate. This position prepares reports, makes recommendations, and performs monitoring activities. Support is available for problems not covered by reference guidelines, and work is checked occasionally during progress and reviewed upon completion.
  
  
**CURRENT VACANCY**
  
The current vacancy is in the **Environmental Services Division** of the **Public Works Department** and will be **assigned to the City's Clean Water Program** which ensures compliance with federal, state, regional and local mandates associated with stormwater runoff and water quality. Through the implementation of its Clean Water Program, the City of Alameda is committed to performing appropriate municipal services and to providing Alameda residents and businesses practical solutions to help reduce stormwater pollution. The Clean Water Program uses a multi-faceted approach to prevent stormwater pollution including: street sweeping; public outreach and education; new development design review; industrial and commercial facility inspections; construction site inspections; illicit discharge inspections and response/enforcement; trash load reduction; heavy metals and legacy pollutant controls; storm drain system cleaning and maintenance; storm drain system improvements and upgrades (e.g. pump stations, storm mains); participation in the Alameda County Clean Water Program; and contributes to a regional water quality monitoring program. We are seeking someone with specialized knowledge and experience administering similar program elements and working with the public to reduce stormwater pollution.

  

**THE COMMUNITY**

The City of Alameda is a unique island community of approximately 80,000 residents in the San Francisco Bay Area. It is connected to the East Bay mainland by four bridges, two underwater tubes, and by ferry services to San Francisco. Alameda is within minutes of the numerous cultural activities in San Francisco, Oakland and Berkeley. A vibrant community with a rich history and small-town charm, Alameda has a diverse mix of housing, neighborhoods, and pedestrian friendly shopping areas. Charming Victorian homes grace shady tree-lined streets covering the island's 23 square miles.

The City is a full-service organization providing residents with a broad range of municipal services including police and fire protection; construction and maintenance of streets, sewers, storm drains, street lights, and other infrastructure; a state-of-the-art library system; and over 400 acres of parks and recreational facilities including multi-use athletic fields, picnic sites, a skate park, a swim center, and a full service senior center. The City owns and operates Alameda Municipal Power, an electric utility serving the needs of all Alameda residents and businesses. Visit the City of Alameda website at: www.alamedaca.gov

  

**THE PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT**
  
The City of Alameda Public Works Department is the steward of Alameda's public infrastructure, responsible for its design, construction, and maintenance. The Department's Five-Year Strategic Plan organizes the department's work into four key focus areas: Resilient Workforce, Sustainable Funding, Reliable Infrastructure, and Effective Service Delivery. Operationally, the Public Works Department is working to be the best organization in the San Francisco Bay Area with focus on making strides to be at the forefront of Public Works best practices, investing in robust GIS, asset management, permitting, finance systems and much more. Come and join our dynamic team to be an integral part of this vision!

**Distinguishing Features**
---------------------------

**BENEFITS OF EMPLOYMENT**

For a comprehensive listing of benefits, see the Benefit Matrix here.

  

* **Work-Life Balance:** Four-day, 36-hour work week (Monday through Thursday).
* **CalPERS Retirement: Classic Members:** 2% at 55 formula, 8.868% contribution; New Members 2% @ 62 formula, 8.75% contribution.
* **Medical:** The City contracts with CalPERS to provide comprehensive health coverage to employees. Multiple HMO and PPO plans available
* **Dental:** Comprehensive dental coverage provided to employees and their eligible dependents.
* **Vacation:** Starting with 75 hours annually and increasing with years of service.
* **Holidays:** 11 City Holidays and 4 floating Holidays.
* **Sick Leave:** 90 hours annually; unused sick leave is converted to service credit at retirement.

**Examples of Duties**
----------------------

* Participates in the design and implementation of programs and activities. Collects and interprets data and prepares reports.

* Prepares and reviews contracts. Evaluates proposals for funding.

* May prepare documents for grant applications and administration.

* Administers programs to ensure compliance with federal, state, regional and local mandates.

* Monitors project progress and compliance with applicable regulations.

* Provides technical assistance to other divisions, departments, organizations, citizen groups, business, etc.

* Reviews budget and expenditure reports and monitors labor and procurement activities.

* Interprets and applies government regulations.

* May coordinate

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Criminal Law & Justice Center (4263C), Berkeley Law #89659
jobs.description:
Program Coordinator, Criminal Law & Justice Center (4263C), Berkeley Law #89659 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
At Berkeley Law, we are committed to excellence in education and scholarship, as well as equality of opportunity. We believe we have a responsibility to use our substantial intellectual capital to help solve real-world problems and to create a more just society through clinics, research, and policy engagement. We believe that a Berkeley Law degree is a tool for change, both locally and globally, and that we should be educating the leaders of tomorrow. We maintain an environment that nurtures academic and personal growth, respects a diversity of ideas, and stimulates independent thought and critical reasoning.
  
  
The Berkeley Criminal Law & Justice Center is a hub for research, education and advocacy. Blending a data-driven approach with zealous advocacy, the center offers empirical insights into the intricacies of the legal system and policy outcomes.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Program Coordinator administers the day-to-day administrative operations for the Criminal Law & Justice Center. Under the direction and supervision of the Center's Executive Director and Managing Director, this position assists in a wide range of administrative services, including event planning, communications and social media, business services, and student services, and possibly including IT, facilities, financial support and fundraising outreach. The Program Coordinator is also responsible for long and short-range strategic event planning and supporting all administrative activities.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is November 11, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Operational Programs and Activities - 40%
  
  
Administers defined operational programs and activities for Criminal Law & Justice Center, which may include some of the following functions: business services, finance, facilities, space planning, student services, human resources, communications, or information technology. Tasks vary in scope and complexity, but require high-level independence, self-direction, and decision-making.
  
Responsible for the day-to-day coordination and administration of the Center and its program.

--------------

Tatcha is a skincare brand rooted in timeless Japanese wisdom, offering transformative yet kind-to-skin formulas that marry Japanese botanicals with clinical ingredients. Our formulation philosophy is informed by the Japanese concept hinou dokon, which means "skin-mind same root"—an acknowledgement of the powerful connection between the skin and the brain. Guided by the mission to care for people through their skin, Tatcha takes a holistic approach to skincare from concept to formulation to clinical evaluation, offering skincare rituals that benefit both skin and mind, while emphasizing the importance of mindfulness to skin health.

**Job Summary**

As the Email Marketing Coordinator at Tatcha you'll be a key member of the eCommerce team. In this hands-on role, you'll build, schedule, and deploy the email and SMS campaigns that bring Tatcha to clients around the world. You'll own the day-to-day execution of our email calendar, partner with creative to brief and deliver campaigns on time, and help the team understand what's working through weekly reporting.

This role is ideal for someone who loves the craft of email: getting the details right, keeping a busy calendar on track, and seeing their work go live every week.

**Key Requirements**

* Build, QA, and schedule promotional email and SMS campaigns in Klaviyo, including segmentation, dynamic content, link and UTM checks, and cross-device rendering tests.
* Own and maintain the email and SMS calendar, keeping send dates, audiences, and deliverables up to date as priorities shift.
* Write creative briefs for each campaign and partner with the creative team to keep deliverables on schedule and aligned with Tatcha's brand voice.
* Proof all campaigns for accuracy, brand consistency, grammar, and offer details before deployment.
* Set up and track A/B tests on subject lines, content, and send times.
* Pull weekly email and SMS performance reports and share highlights with the team.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in business, communications, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 1–2 years of experience in email, CRM, or digital channel marketing preferred.

* Basic HTML/CSS skills for editing email templates.
* Strong copyediting skills and a sharp eye for grammar, spelling, and brand consistency.
* Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets for reporting.
* Detail-oriented: you catch the broken link, the wrong date, and the typo before anyone else does.

* Adaptable, keeping things moving when timelines or priorities change.

**About Refold AI**

Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.

Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.

**Traction:** 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.

We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. Our buyers don't come from paid ads — they come from the room. Practice leaders, integration architects, and product executives who trust each other more than they trust a vendor. This seat owns that room.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Own the event calendar:** Plan, run, and measure our presence at PMA, SAP Connect, TSIA, Ai4, and the industry moments where our buyers actually gather. Speaking slots, booths, side events, and the follow-up that turns a conversation into a meeting
* **Run the dinner series:** Executive networking dinners in target metros are one of our best pipeline sources. Own the guest list, the format, the venue, and the outcome — and scale it beyond one city
* **Produce** ***Unfolded*****:** Our podcast is a ten-minute rapid-fire format built to open doors with mid-funnel accounts. Own guest sourcing, booking, production, and the recap content that gives each episode a second life
* **Build the webinar engine:** Recurring, genuinely useful sessions with customers, partners, and practitioners — not thinly disguised demos
* **Build the community:** Create a place where integration and delivery leaders at software companies want to be. Our credibility comes from being useful to this group before we sell them anything
* **Carry a pipeline number:** Field marketing here is measured in meetings booked, opportunities sourced, and pipeline influenced. Badge scans are not the metric

* **Field marketing track record:** 5–8 years in community, field, or event marketing at B2B SaaS, with meaningful time at a Series A or B company where you owned the calendar rather than supported it
* **You've run the room:** Conferences, executive dinners, roadshows, and side events — you've done the venue calls, the guest list triage, the run-of-show, and the awkward moment when a speaker cancels at 6 pm

* **Builder DNA:** No events team, no agency, no MDF. You'll book the venue and write the invite copy yourself, and that's the appealing part, not the problem

============================

Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it.

Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. We go beyond leaderboards and decompose what human experience reveals about AI, so models advance toward the work people actually do.

We're a team of researchers, academics, builders, and creatives from UC Berkeley, Google, Stanford, and DeepMind. We seek truth, move fast, and value craftsmanship, curiosity, and impact over hierarchy. We're building a company where thoughtful, curious people from all backgrounds can do their best work together, in an office culture that radiates excellence, energy, and focus.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the ongoing technical relationship through the entire lifecycle of customers in your portfolio, collaborating very closely alongside the Customer Success and wider account teams. This role will serve as a trusted technical advisor responsible for defining the Braze technology strategy for customers who have purchased the TAM premium service offering and helping them unlock value from their use of the Braze platform.

Your focus will be to drive value, retention, and adoption of Braze's product through the customer lifecycle, acting as the technical counterpart between Braze and your client's product and engineering team. You will be responsible for understanding your customer's needs and proactively driving forward technical initiatives that help your customers achieve their business goals.

You'll manage a portfolio of named accounts, typically in the Enterprise and Strategic classification of accounts, a tier of customers with enterprise organizational structures and architectures, posing unique geographical, scale, and complexity challenges.

This is an opportunity to bring your experience as a product and implementation expert, business analyst, problem solver, and customer success professional along with a high level of product and technical competence, delivering high-impact engagements that drive tangible outcomes for some of Braze's most advanced customers.

* You'll be responsible for client success, partnering with the Customer Success Team to own the technical relationship for your assigned accounts and help drive technical adoption, accelerated technical value, and continued technical maturity
* Help customers successfully instrument Braze across their stack and refine that instrumentation over time as their use of Braze matures and becomes even more valuable, which in turn contributes to renewals and upsells
* Facilitate conversations regarding the customers' desired use case, conducting discovery, and recommending solutions based on their unique needs and architecture
* Support and advocate for day-to-day inquiries and requests to support optimization and value through the customer lifecycle
* Empower customer product and engineering teams to use our product as independently and efficiently as possible, communicating with customers and internal teams to explain products and solutions by delivering enablement and education
* Adopt governance practices such as creating solutions documentation and building architectural diagrams, and drive progress against key technical work streams through project management
