Asset Living is a third-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.

  

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.

  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

**COMMUNITY MANAGER**

The Community Manager is responsible for overseeing the entire operations of a housing community under the supervision of the Regional Manager. As a Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration & risk management. As an on-site leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with Asset’s policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Personnel Management
* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques & company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop on-site staff
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Complete weekly/daily office & maintenance staff schedules and assignments
* Deal effectively and consistently with performance problems; document adequately, communicate with direct supervisor and HR, and terminate appropriately when necessary.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures
* Financial Management
* Achieve the highest possible net operating income through the implementation of effective cost control and revenue & leasing improvement; identify trends and recommend strategies and adjustments
* Develop yearly operating budgets/forecasts
* Monitor the timely receipt and reconciliation of deposits, rent collections, and charges to ensure they are submitted on a timely basis.
* Monitor the timely receipt, reconciliation, and coding of all vendor invoices
* Ensure property closeout is completed on time and ownership financial reports are accurate
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Develop yearly marketing plan and utilize marketing strategies & systems
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents
* Administrative & Maintenance Management
* Ensure all administrative & leasing reporting is accurate, complete, and submitted on a timely basis
* Will head emergency team for the property; ensure proper response and handling of all property emergencies with staff, residents, buildings, etc., within company guidelines to minimize liability.
* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.
* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, and contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)
* Give direction to and monitor maintenance, construction, and rehabilitation activities to ensure quality and expediency (i.e., “walk” units to ensure make-ready and work orders are completed)

**Education/experience**

* High School Diploma or Equivalent; Bachelor’s degree preferred or four year’s experience in the housing industry; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Must have basic knowledge of Fair Housing Laws and OSHA requirements.

We're looking for an Operations Associate who wants to learn how an early-stage startup actually runs by helping run it, and are seeking someone who thrives at the intersection of organization, execution, and AI.

**What will the Operations Associate do?**
------------------------------------------

The Operations Associate keeps Veritus running: the San Francisco office, the leadership team's operating cadence, and the cross-functional projects our COO needs done, so that routine work runs on schedule and every important item gets done.

Reporting directly to our COO, Kasia Gora, you will split your time roughly evenly between running our San Francisco office and owning operational projects for the COO. From the Monday leadership meeting to the holiday party, you will manage meeting materials, OKR tracking, vendors and budgets, interview scheduling, new hire setup, team events, and business travel. You'll work with the COO every day and with the whole leadership team, and there is a clear path to Chief of Staff for the right person.

**Who will love this job?**
---------------------------

* You thrive when you can drive high impact across a whole company, and you bring the same care to every task, big or small. You're energized by learning how an early-stage startup actually runs by helping run it.
* You are relentlessly positive and view yourself as a pillar of company culture, and you get excited by all the possibilities to shape it through your work and interactions.
* You enjoy working in an entrepreneurial, AI-first environment where AI tools are the first thing you reach for.
* You are an execution expert: you keep dozens of open items on track with trackers and checklists, and you finish each one on your own, so the COO only has to ask once.
* You feel at home working with people inside and outside the company: you coordinate schedules across the leadership team, candidates, and interviewers, and you follow up with vendors and procurement teams until you have what you need. You take pride in how you show up, knowing that you are a beacon of Veritus’ values and culture!
* You communicate with precision: your updates, follow-ups, and SOPs are concise, accurate, and polished, so leaders can act on them right away.
* You take pride in building repeatable processes: you like turning a manual workflow into a documented, AI-assisted process that someone else could run.
* You are a scrappy, relentless problem-solver who figures things out and writes the playbook as you go, and who measures success by outcomes: action items closed, materials ready on deadline, and an office that runs smoothly because you run it.
* You want your work to matter and you want to work with folks who both laugh and get things done. You bring rigor as well as a sense of humor!

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Leadership Operations**

* Run the leadership team's operating cadence: schedule leadership meetings and offsites, track OKRs, and follow up on action items until they close.
* Prepare recurring company materials, including weekly All Hands slides and KPI reporting, ready by the deadline every week.
* Take special projects off the COO's plate and run them end to end.

**Office Management and Events Planning**

* Run the San Francisco office: snacks and supplies, packages and shipping, vendors, mail, guests, facilities, and the office budget.
* Schedule and support company offsites, internal team events, and business events, on budget and on time.
* Coordinate business travel for the team.

**Hiring and Onboarding**

* Schedule all candidate interviews promptly as candidates advance.
* Get every new hire's desk, office access, welcome basket, and first-week schedule ready for day one, using a checklist you build and maintain.

**Finance and Processes**

* Assist with invoicing, accounts receivable follow-up, budgets, and expense tracking.
* Turn repetitive workflows into documented, AI-assisted processes that someone else could run.
* Jump on new and unexpected tasks as they come up.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

Our ideal candidate...

* …has experience in an operations, office management, project coordination, or similar organizational role.
* …is smart and quick to learn, with a strong work ethic and a deep sense of ownership.
* …is eloquent in writing and in person: concise, accurate, and polished.
* …is incredibly organized, with meticulous attention to detail.
* …is humble, eager to learn, and ready to grow with the company.
* …takes on every task, from leadership meeting prep to restocking the snacks, with the same care.

* …uses AI tools every day, and using AI is as second nature as using Google Workspace and Slack.

**Title:** Real Estate Operations Coordinator

**Business Unit:** Real Estate

**Work Schedule:** Hybrid

**Status:** Full-Time

**FLSA Status:** Non-Exempt

**Work Location:** Mountain View, CA

**Date Submitted:** October 2026

**Salary Range:** $80k to 90k plus bonus eligibility

**JOB SUMMARY**

This position involves providing administrative and analytic support to the Asset Management and Property Management departments with their operational and investment activities of Sobrato’s real estate portfolio. The portfolio consists of approximately 8,000 multifamily units and over 6 million square feet of commercial assets. The portfolio is located along the West Coast with a significant concentration in the SF Bay Area.

The position will have primary responsibilities with the Asset and Property Management departments and will interact with all real estate business groups, including Development, Leasing/Transactions, Portfolio Management, and Sustainability. This role’s specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to, managing due diligence/closing processes, maintaining databases, drafting written correspondence to external parties, and supporting the preparation of budgets. This position involves both individual and collaborative work.

**RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS**

**Job Responsibility 1: Portfolio Operations Support**

60% of Time

* Provide support to the Multifamily Asset Management and Commercial Property Management teams with the operations and management of their portfolios.
* Maintain property, vendor, and commercial tenant databases by updating contact information, lease information, vendor scheduling, and other key data.
* Draft written correspondence to commercial tenants for lease administrative matters such as rent increases and CAM reimbursement bill backs.
* Assist with contract administration, including (i) preparing and filing proposals/service contracts with 3rd party vendors; (ii) obtaining vendor insurance certificates; and (iii) preparing/filing termination of service letters.
* Assist with responding to vendor and commercial tenant requests and help coordinate schedules between the Property Managers and the vendors/tenants for meetings.
* Provide support with preparing budgets, tenant CAM estimates, and year-end reconciliations.
* Provide support with compiling budgetary expenses for taxes, insurance, and debt service.
* Perform periodic audits of third-party management firms, including expense pass-throughs, incentive compensation, cash retention/disbursement policies, and management fees.
* Manage housing assistance payment allocation and distribution to properties.
* Oversee the process for collection of commercial tenant maintenance records.
* Manage energy reporting systems (Energy Star, Measurabl) for data quality assurance and assist with reporting/benchmarking requirements.
* Manage the annual budget process by creating project timelines, scheduling site inspections, completing data entry, and gathering/filing vendor proposals.
* Establish and maintain relationships with lenders to include coordination of periodic site inspections, quarterly financial reporting, and lender compliance requirements
* Work closely with accounting and finance departments to ensure accurate and timely payments of invoices, particularly property taxes.
* Assist with coding of invoices as needed.
* Review financial reports for aged receivables and payables as needed.
* Maintain all property files in Box, including monthly 3rd Party financial statements, construction documentation, and blueprints in hard copy and electronic format.
* Manage calendars, coordinate meetings, and conference calls
* File documents as needed.
* Obtain a notary license and notarize internal documents as needed.
* Assist with property tax appeals by gathering requested information and ensuring the appeal continues to progress as needed.
* Review and approve 3rd party reimbursements.
* Take the lead with 3rd party document retention, such as MOR’s and other pertinent financial or operating reports.
* Assist the MF team with preparing the Weekly Rent Summary reporting.
* Prepare owner-paid expenses for inclusion and property financials.

**Job Responsibility 2: Transactions Coordinator**

30% of Time

* Assist with managing the transaction process for acquisitions, dispositions, and financings from initial screening to closing.
* Lead the process of engaging 3rd party vendors and consultants that will be assisting with the diligence and closing of transactions.
* Perform initial review of vendor proposals and third-party drafts for accuracy and provide recommendations for adjustments when necessary.
* Track key milestones, deadlines, and contingencies to ensure timely execution.
* Maintain and update transaction records for the status of due diligence files and manage the file-sharing process.
* Help review and prepare post-closing reconciliations.
* Work closely with legal counsel, 1031 tax exchange advisors, and title and escrow officers on the preparation, execution, and distribution of closing documents.
* Communicate proactively with all parties to provide status updates and to identify issues.

**Job Responsibility 3: Website & Intranet Management**

5% of Time

* Work in partnership with the VP of Communications on creating engaging content that highlights the Real Estate group’s successes and impact.
* Assist with the management of the company’s website and intranet pages to ensure that relevant real estate content is posted in a timely manner.

**Job Responsibility 4: Other Responsibilities as Assigned**

5% of Time

* Other responsibilities as assigned

**Education / Training**

* High school diploma and commensurate experience.
* An associate or bachelor's degree is a plus.

**Experience/Technical Skills**

**Required:**

* 5+ years of experience in a similar role.

jobs.title: Design Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the Eames Institute**
=============================

The Eames Institute of Infinite Curiosity is a nonprofit public charity dedicated to advancing the dynamic legacy of 20th-century designers Ray and Charles Eames. By sharing the things the Eameses made and loved, along with their joyful and rigorous approach to life and work, we seek to inspire creative problem-solving that positively shapes our world.

With our vast collections, digital and print offerings, an extensive program of events, and the Eames Ranch, we aim to demonstrate the enduring value of the Eameses' philosophy and invite people to explore their curiosity, ask questions, and implement creative solutions to the challenges of today.

**About the Role**
==================

The Design Production Coordinator supports the development and execution of the Eames Institute's visual identity across print, digital, retail, exhibitions, events, and experiential platforms. This role provides day-to-day support to the Creative Lead and broader marketing and communications team, helping move projects from concept through completion. The Design Production Coordinator focuses on project coordination, creative asset management, and administrative responsibilities, with an opportunity to provide hands-on design support.

Working closely with the Creative Lead, this role translates creative concepts into thoughtful, polished visual communications that reflect the Eames Institute's mission, aesthetic, and brand standards. This is an opportunity for an early-career operations professional to further develop their design production skills while gaining broad experience across a wide range of creative projects and mediums. The ideal candidate is curious, detail-oriented, collaborative, visually minded, and highly organized, with the ability to track creative work with the operational details that bring designs to life.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Creative Operations & Project Coordination**

* Support the Creative Lead in tracking projects, deadlines, priorities, and deliverables.
* Maintain project trackers, calendars, and status updates.
* Coordinate project information and follow up with internal teams to ensure materials and approvals are received on time.
* Assist with project intake, file routing, approvals, revisions, and final delivery.
* Coordinate with printers, vendors, photographers, illustrators, and other creative partners as needed.
* Prepare materials and documentation for creative meetings and reviews.
* Help identify and communicate upcoming deadlines and project needs.
* Support Creative Lead in developing and evolving processes both internally and with external stakeholders.

### **Asset & Data Management**

* Organize and maintain digital creative assets, including images, artwork, templates, presentations, and final files.
* Enter and maintain project, asset, and other creative information in internal systems and databases.
* Ensure files and records are accurately labeled, organized, and up to date.
* Assist with image and asset metadata, tagging, and cataloging.
* Help maintain shared folders, archives, templates, and other creative resources.
* Support ongoing efforts to improve the organization and accessibility of the Creative team's assets.

### **Administrative Support**

* Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Creative Lead, including scheduling meeting preparation and follow-up.
* Assist with organizing creative team meetings, presentations, and project reviews.
* Track invoices, purchase orders, and other project-related administrative information as needed.
* Assist with gathering information and preparing reports, lists, and presentations.
* Manage routine correspondence and follow-up related to creative projects.
* Take on special projects and other administrative responsibilities that support the effectiveness of the marketing and communications team.

### **Creative & Design Support**

* Support the Creative Lead in developing and executing visual design materials across print, digital, social media, email, retail, event materials, and other organizational needs.
* Adapt and update existing creative concepts, templates, and brand assets for different applications and formats.
* Create layouts, graphics, presentations, and other visual design collateral under the direction of the Creative Lead.
* Assist with the preparation of print- and production-ready files.
* Support creative research, mood boards, image sourcing, and presentation development.
* Help maintain consistency of the Eames Institute visual identity across communications and touchpoints.
* Participate in creative reviews and incorporate feedback into design work.

**Required skills, abilities, competencies**
============================================

* Experience in creative operations and/or production management positions.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, file management systems, and other administrative tools.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to take direction, receive feedback, and work collaboratively.
* Proactive approach to identifying what needs to be done and following through.
* Comfortable moving between creative, administrative, and operational tasks throughout the day.
* A plus if you have:
* + An interest in architecture, art, culture, publishing, and/or the legacy of Charles and Ray Eames.
  + Demonstrated interest and ability in graphic design, with a portfolio or examples of design work including print and digital.

There are some administrative responsibilities along with project responsibilities. Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. **Job Description**
-------------------

The Transportation Planning and Management Division (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, and ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
Research, Implementation, and Safety unit (RIS) is a multi-disciplinary team dedicated to making the streets of New York City safer for all users as part of Vision Zero, a citywide policy striving to eliminate serious injuries and fatalities from traffic crashes. RIS uses a data-driven approach to design and implement street safety redesign projects, administer safety programs, promote senior and youth safety, manage crash data and data applications, conduct large-scale safety research projects, and lead agency action plans related to safety and Vision Zero programs/policy.
  
  
RIS’ Safety Projects and Programs team is seeking candidates for a Project Coordinator position. The candidate will be responsible for planning, developing, designing, conducting outreach, and implementing Street Improvement Projects to improve safety for pedestrians, motor vehicles, bicyclists, transit riders, and motorcyclists, with a focus on the goals of the Streets Plan and Vision Zero. The position will focus on incorporating proven safety treatments to improve safety for all users as part of DOT’s commitment to Vision Zero and improving the safety, reliability, and accessibility of transit corridors.
  
  
Key tasks for this position include performing research and crash analysis to identify high crash locations, scoping and designing safety improvement projects for high crash locations, analyzing traffic data, preparing reports/graphics and maps, conducting field work including on-site evaluations and field meetings, coordinating project implementation, and providing technical assistance to senior staff. The selected candidates will also be required to participate in community outreach, including developing outreach plans and materials meetings with public officials, Community Boards, and inter- and intra-agency stakeholders. The ideal candidate should be detail-oriented, a capable team player, and possess excellent communication skills. This is an opportunity to work with a team dedicated to improving safety, accessibility, and mobility throughout New York City.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  
  

1. A master’s degree from an accredited college or university in city planning, urban planning, urban design, architecture, landscape architecture, transportation engineering, public administration, economic development or a related field; or
  
  
2. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university and one year of satisfactory full-time experience in city planning such as in the review and
  
development of housing, transportation, environmental, and city-owned land planning projects; or
  
  
3. A satisfactory combination of education and/or experience that is equivalent to "1" above. Graduate education in city planning, urban planning, urban design, architecture, landscape architecture, transportation engineering, public administration, economic development or related fields may be substituted for experience on the basis of 30 graduate semester credits from an accredited college or university for one year of experience. However, all candidates must have a baccalaureate degree.
  
  
4. To be eligible for placement in Assignment Level III, individuals must have, after meeting the minimum requirements, two additional years of professional experience as described in "2" above.

  
  

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

  
The preferred candidate will be proficient in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Adobe Creative Suite. Experience in AutoCAD, GIS, and traffic engineering software is a plus. Knowledge of traffic calming, urban design, pedestrian-oriented design, complete streets, and traffic engineering is required. Excellent writing, editing, oral presentation, and community outreach skills a must. Valid NYS Preference will be given to candidate who possess a driver's license valid in the state of New York with no restrictions. New York, NY

### **About Nominal**

Nominal is building the connected test and operations platform powering the world’s most advanced hardware systems, from spacecraft and autonomous vehicles to next-generation defense programs. Our platform gives hardware engineering teams a single place to ingest data, analyze performance, automate test execution, and collaborate across every phase of development so they can move faster without sacrificing safety or precision. We are a fast-moving team that owns problems end to end, works across disciplines, and thrives at the intersection of hardware and software.

We serve top-tier commercial and defense customers including autonomy leaders like Anduril and Shield AI, next-generation aerospace teams such as Hermeus and REGENT, and performance engineering teams like Pratt Miller Motorsports. We also partner with mission teams within the U.S. Navy and U.S. Air Force on programs where failure is not an option.

  
  

Nominal is backed by Sequoia, General Catalyst, Founders Fund, Lux Capital, and Lightspeed. Our team includes people from SpaceX, Palantir, Anduril, Applied Intuition, and other leading companies, united by a common mission: giving hardware engineers the tools to build the future with speed, safety, and confidence.

  
  

### **About the role**

Nominal’s Engineering, Product & Design (EPD) org is growing fast, and we’re building a small EPD admin team to support the whole department: its leaders, its recurring meetings, and the way work gets scheduled and coordinated. As our first Administrative Coordinator, you’ll own a defined lane of that work, running day-to-day scheduling and travel for a group of engineering and product leads and keeping EPD’s planning cycles and events on track.

  
  

This role is ideal for someone early in their admin career who loves process and systems and wants to grow alongside a team that’s building something new. You’ll work closely with our admin team lead, who designs the operating model, and you’ll be the one making it run, flagging where it could run better.

  
  

### **What you’ll do:**

* Run scheduling for a group of EPD leads, coordinating cross-team meetings across time zones and shifting priorities within each lead’s set norms.
* Schedule and support EPD’s recurring leadership meetings and quarterly planning cycles so the department’s rhythms stay on track.
* Book travel for EPD leads and coordinate logistics for offsites, team events, and in-office gatherings with our events and operations teams.
* Set up new EPD leads on calendars, recurring meetings, and admin norms during their first weeks.
* Run and refine AI-assisted scheduling and coordination routines, and check their output before it reaches a calendar or an inbox.
* Keep SOPs, templates, and trackers current, and flag repeated friction to the admin team lead with a suggested fix.
* Field admin requests from across EPD, prioritize them against each other, and communicate clearly about timing.
  

  

### **We’re looking for someone with**

* 2+ years of administrative or coordinator experience supporting several people or a team in a high-volume environment (tech preferred).
* Strong calendar skills, including comfort with many attendees, competing priorities, and plans that change.
* Hands-on use of AI tools in your work today, with concrete examples, including times you chose not to trust the output.
* A track record of making a process easier for others, such as a template, tracker, or SOP that people kept using.
* Clear, concise writing in email, Slack, and docs that is easy to act on, since much of our team works across offices.
* Discretion with calendars, inboxes, and people matters.
* Professional maturity and a service mindset: at ease with senior leaders, steady when priorities collide, kind but clear about where a request fits, and quick to own mistakes.
  

* **Skills that supercharge us**

* Experience with event logistics such as offsites, co-locations, and team events.
* Experience setting up an AI assistant or automation for others (Claude, Notion AI, Zapier, or similar).
* Experience supporting an engineering or product organization.
* Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Linear, or Ramp.
  

  
  
  

**✨ Benefits/Perks**

* 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance
* **️** Unlimited PTO and sick leave
* **️** Free lunch, snacks, and coffee
* Professional Development Stipend
* ️ In-office hardware lab with a $250 project stipend
* **✈️** Annual company retreat
  

  

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.*

Event Operations Manager – Mobile Coffee Catering  
**Full-time | Extensive travel required**

Lead the team. Own the details. Deliver the experience.

Express Kafeh is hiring a hands-on **Event Operations Manager** to lead the execution of our mobile espresso catering services at conventions, trade shows, corporate events, and private functions on the road locally around the country.

Established in 2011, Express Kafeh brings premium coffee experiences to events across the United States and internationally. Our work combines hospitality, equipment, logistics, and teamwork—and every successful event depends on getting the details right.

You will take ownership of assigned events from preparation and equipment readiness through setup, service, breakdown, and final reporting. You must be equally comfortable speaking with a client, directing baristas, checking inventory, loading equipment, and stepping in when something needs fixing.

**This position involves frequent travel, physical work, early mornings, evenings, weekends, and overnight stays.**

What You Will Do

**Prepare each event for success**

* Review event orders, service requirements, schedules, staffing plans, venue instructions, and client expectations.
* Coordinate with our Director of Operations, account managers, warehouse team, and travel coordinator.
* Verify that equipment, supplies, branding, and backup materials are complete, tested, and ready.
* Lead in staging, packing, loading, and inventory checks.
* Confirm access, loading arrangements, power requirements, setup timing, and other essential venue details.
* Identify missing information or potential problems early and follow through until resolved.

**Lead setup and event service**

* Direct in unloading, station setup, equipment testing, and final presentation.
* Brief baristas and support staff on assignments, service standards, schedules, and expectations.
* Ensure every station is clean, properly stocked, operational, and ready before service begins.
* Supervise attendance, appearance, breaks, replenishment, and service performance.
* Maintain a visible presence throughout the event, checking stations and supporting the team.
* Address staffing gaps, equipment problems, supply shortages, and client concerns promptly.
* Step in wherever needed, including assisting with beverage service.
* Follow safety procedures and escalate issues requiring management approval.

**Complete the job properly**

* Lead equipment cleaning, breakdown, packing, loading, and return.
* Reconcile equipment and supplies, documenting missing items, damage, and maintenance needs.
* Verify staff hours and submit required receipts and expense records.
* Complete event reports covering service results, client feedback, staff performance, incidents, and improvements.
* Follow through on outstanding items until the event is fully closed out.

What You Bring

**Required qualifications**

* At least **3 years of relevant experience** in catering, banquets, conventions, event production, hospitality operations, or a comparable hands-on field.
* Experience directly supervising staff in a busy service environment.
* Strong organization and follow-through, including the ability to manage several stations or competing priorities.
* Practical problem-solving skills and confidence handling equipment and learning basic troubleshooting.
* Professional communication and a customer-focused approach.
* Comfort using email, shared calendars, Google Drive, spreadsheets, and digital checklists.
* A valid driver’s license and willingness to drive for company assignments.
* Availability for frequent overnight and multiday travel.
* Flexibility to work early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays as event schedules require.
* Ability to perform essential physical duties, including extended standing, loading and unloading, and moving event equipment, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Mobile catering, coffee catering, trade show, or convention experience.
* Barista experience or familiarity with commercial espresso equipment.
* Experience with inventory control, warehouse coordination, freight, or equipment logistics.
* Experience leading temporary staff or teams working together for the first time.
* Experience tracking event expenses and working within an approved budget.

**Coffee experience is a plus. Proven leadership, reliability, and operational judgment are essential.**

How to Apply

Submit your résumé and a brief introduction describing:

* Your experience leading event, hospitality, catering, or operations teams.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the ongoing technical relationship through the entire lifecycle of customers in your portfolio, collaborating very closely alongside the Customer Success and wider account teams. This role will serve as a trusted technical advisor responsible for defining the Braze technology strategy for customers who have purchased the TAM premium service offering and helping them unlock value from their use of the Braze platform.

Your focus will be to drive value, retention, and adoption of Braze's product through the customer lifecycle, acting as the technical counterpart between Braze and your client's product and engineering team. You will be responsible for understanding your customer's needs and proactively driving forward technical initiatives that help your customers achieve their business goals.

You'll manage a portfolio of named accounts, typically in the Enterprise and Strategic classification of accounts, a tier of customers with enterprise organizational structures and architectures, posing unique geographical, scale, and complexity challenges.

This is an opportunity to bring your experience as a product and implementation expert, business analyst, problem solver, and customer success professional along with a high level of product and technical competence, delivering high-impact engagements that drive tangible outcomes for some of Braze's most advanced customers.

* You'll be responsible for client success, partnering with the Customer Success Team to own the technical relationship for your assigned accounts and help drive technical adoption, accelerated technical value, and continued technical maturity
* Help customers successfully instrument Braze across their stack and refine that instrumentation over time as their use of Braze matures and becomes even more valuable, which in turn contributes to renewals and upsells
* Facilitate conversations regarding the customers' desired use case, conducting discovery, and recommending solutions based on their unique needs and architecture
* Support and advocate for day-to-day inquiries and requests to support optimization and value through the customer lifecycle
* Empower customer product and engineering teams to use our product as independently and efficiently as possible, communicating with customers and internal teams to explain products and solutions by delivering enablement and education
* Adopt governance practices such as creating solutions documentation and building architectural diagrams, and drive progress against key technical work streams through project management
* Instill best practice and engineering excellence amongst your customer portfolio by validating product use cases and technical feasibility for product launch and translating the customers' unique requirements to Braze's Product team

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3-5 years client-facing experience as a TAM or in a related technical area such in Implementation, Technical Support, or Solutions Architecture, for a product offering serving Enterprise/Strategic accounts
* 3+ years of technical experience in managing complex customer environments with strong product command and technical knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, API, or Programming
* You are an excellent communicator (written and verbal skills), with demonstrable customer communication and coordination efforts, and the ability to take complex technical ideas and translate them to non-technical stakeholders
* You are a natural problem solver with a high level of intellectual curiosity and love working amongst a team to solve those problems
* You are able to maintain a high level of productivity, manage multiple competing priorities, and work effectively under the pressure of time constraints in a fast-paced, complex, and collaborative environment
* You may have bilingual skills beyond English that facilitate us talking with our global customer base in their native language. Please note that this is not a requirement for the role but something that we welcome in our team

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $90,000 and $130,500/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $102,000 and $145,000/year (including bonus or commission). In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

*Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at* *here**. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.*

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze off

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Logicbroker, Inc.**

Logicbroker is the Agentic Commerce Orchestration Engine helping enterprise retailers, brands, suppliers, and distributors connect and grow. Our Intelligent Commerce Network powers over $10B in GMV for global leaders like Samsung, Walgreens, and Home Depot by automating the entire process from discovery to doorstep and stock to dock. We make products discoverable, shoppable, fulfillable, and returnable so our clients can grow faster, delight customers, and run smarter operations.

**Job Summary**

We're hiring a Revenue Operations Engineer to own the systems, data and processes behind our go-to-market team. You'll own HubSpot and the revenue tool stack end to end, and personally build integrations, automations and AI-assisted workflows that help the team create and convert more effectively.

This is a builder role. The foundation is in place: a HubSpot Enterprise data model, ARR and renewal reporting, a MEDDPICC framework and an AI-assisted RevOps roadmap. Your job is to turn that into a planning, reporting and deal execution engine that leadership runs the business on.

**What You'll Do:**

* Own HubSpot Enterprise as the system of record: data model, pipelines, properties, automation, permissions and data quality.
* Own the revenue tool stack, including data enrichment, conversation intelligence, CPQ and e-signature, and make the tools work together through clean integrations.
* Write and maintain SOPs for how deals, renewals, handoffs and approvals move through the business.
* Find friction in the revenue process and fix it, with a bias toward automation and AI, measuring adoption, reliability, time saved and impact on pipeline or conversion.
* Support forecasting and pipeline reviews with sales leadership, and give reps dashboards and actionable account context.
* Partner with Finance on ARR, bookings and renewal reporting so the CRM and the books agree.
* Personally build and troubleshoot workflows using APIs, automation platforms and AI coding tools, partnering with AI Engineering Team on more complex projects and production reliability.
* Manage contractors and vendors to deliver system builds on time.
* Work with GTM team to turn customer conversations, account signals and won / lost deal patterns into better targeting, prioritization and relevant sales angles, acting as a strategic advisor to leadership on go-to-market design, pricing operations and growth levers.

**What You'll Own First**

* **Workflow automation, in Sales, Marketing and CS.** Build and maintain workflows for account research, enrichment, routing, follow-ups, and CRM updates, along with annual and quarterly planning process: territories, quota setting, capacity models and pipeline coverage targets, in partnership with the ELT.
* **Reporting and insights.** Streamline reporting into a single source of truth for pipeline, forecast, ARR and renewals. Cut manual reporting and get leadership answers faster.
* **Contracting process.** Improve and automate end-to-end quote-to-contract workflow covering templates, approvals, e-signature and CRM handoff.
* **Deal desk.** Build approval workflows for pricing, discounting and non-standard terms, using thresholds and policies set by Finance and leadership.

**What We Need:**

* 5+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or GTM systems, ideally at a B2B SaaS company.
* A builder track record: you've personally built and maintained processes, integrations, systems and automated workflows from scratch, with evidence of adoption and measurable results.
* Hands-on CRM administration experience, comfortable building properties, workflows, reports and dashboards yourself.
* Experience writing SOPs and driving adoption of new processes across Sales, Marketing and CS.
* Experience integrating GTM tools through APIs and managing data flow between systems, including troubleshooting failures.
* Hands-on experience using AI coding tools and automation platforms to ship working solutions, with the ability to write and debug code when needed.
* Working knowledge of SaaS metrics: ARR, net revenue retention, pipeline coverage, win rate and sales cycle.
* Firsthand experience learning from customer or sales conversations and using those insights to improve targeting, messaging or revenue workflows, along with quota, territory and capacity modeling.
* Clear communication with executives; you can turn messy data into a decision.

**Nice to have**

* Deep HubSpot experience across Sales Hub, Marketing Hub or Service Hub, especially at the Enterprise tier.
* Experience standing up a deal desk or contracting function.
* Exposure to multi-entity or multi-brand CRM environments.
* Familiarity with dropship, marketplace, ecommerce or supply chain software.

**Why Logicbroker:**

**Mission-Driven Culture:** Be part of a company transforming digital commerce through innovation and agility—your work directly shapes how global brands connect with customers.

**Collaborative, No-Ego Environment:** We believe the best ideas win, not the loudest voices. You’ll work alongside teammates who challenge and support each other.

**Flexibility with High-Performance Energy:** Whether remote or in-office, we foster autonomy and accountability—because we trust you to own your success.

**Leadership That Listens:** Our executives are not just accessible—they’re invested in your growth, open to your ideas, and committed to building a company where people thrive.

**Celebrated Wins, Shared Learnings:** From team offsites to Slack shoutouts, we celebrate progress and learn from setbacks together

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
125,000 - 130,000 USD per year(New York)

**Key Account Sales Operations Specialist**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

SANY America is seeking a Key Account Sales Operations Specialist to support its expanding key account business through accurate sales order management, equipment delivery coordination, forecasting, and inventory planning. Working closely with Key Account Managers, Sales Operations, Logistics, Service, Finance, and factory teams, this position helps ensure timely fulfillment of telehandlers and other equipment while delivering a consistent customer experience.

With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase its market share.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Sales Order Management**

* Receive, review, and track orders from Key Account Managers; verify pricing, equipment specifications, quantities, delivery requirements, and approved payment terms.

* Compare customer purchase orders with quotations and agreements, resolving discrepancies before processing.

* Enter and maintain orders in applicable systems; communicate inventory availability, production status, lead times, and changes to Key Account Managers.

**Delivery, PDI & Invoicing Coordination**

* Coordinate equipment allocation, pre-delivery inspections (PDI), required modifications, and shipment readiness with internal teams.

* Track delivery schedules, escalate delays affecting customer commitments, and support timely issue resolution.

* Coordinate with Finance on accurate, timely invoicing; maintain purchase orders, approvals, delivery records, and invoices.

**Sales Forecasting & Inventory Planning**

* Reconcile forecasts against confirmed orders, available inventory, inbound shipments, and factory production schedules.

* Recommend replenishment quantities and configurations based on demand and customer requirements; monitor stock shortages, aging, excess inventory, and turnover.

* Coordinate factory orders and track production schedule changes and estimated arrival dates.

**Key Account Bids & Proposals**

* Coordinate RFP, RFQ, and key account bid responses with the responsible Key Account Manager.

* Maintain requirement checklists, internal owners, document inventories, approval steps, and submission deadlines.

* Track clarifications and addenda, coordinate internal reviews and submissions, retain bid records, and transition awarded bids to order processing.

**HQ Coordination, Reporting & Customer Support**

* Serve as a coordination point for factory and headquarters requests involving specifications, production priorities, order changes, and approvals.

* Maintain action trackers and follow up across departments to resolve outstanding matters and improve workflows.

* Provide timely updates to Key Account Managers; proactively flag issues that may affect customer experience.

* Associate degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Experience maintaining detailed order records, coordinating across departments, and meeting time-sensitive deadlines.

* Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office skills, with the ability to reconcile, analyze, and communicate operational data.

* Ability to communicate professionally and accurately with internal stakeholders and customer-facing teams.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related field.

* Experience in heavy equipment, construction machinery, telehandlers, industrial equipment, or an OEM/dealer environment.

* Familiarity with CRM/ERP systems, sales order processing, inventory planning, and equipment delivery or PDI processes.

* Experience supporting RFP/RFQ responses, multi-department approvals, and coordination with international factory teams.

**SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple orders, deadlines, and stakeholders.

* Proficiency in reporting, spreadsheet analysis, forecast reconciliation, and accurate recordkeeping.

Account Manager | Insurance & Financial Services

**Atlanta, GA | Full-Time | In-Office + Limited WFH**

Angie Sue Brown State Farm Agency opened in 2018 and is located right by Piedmont Park, where Midtown, Virginia-Highland, Ansley Park, and Morningside come together.

We’re a local insurance and financial services agency, but relationships are really at the center of what we do. We want our customers to know who we are, trust us, and feel like they have a real person they can call when they need help.

That same philosophy applies to our team.

We’re a small, close-knit office where your work matters and your contribution is noticed. We like to have fun, we support each other, and we genuinely enjoy the people we work with—but we also work hard.

**We want to be transparent about that from the beginning.**

This is not a position where you wait for work to come to you. You’ll have goals, make calls, follow up consistently, learn a lot, and be expected to contribute to the success of the agency. In return, you'll have the opportunity to earn more based on your performance, build valuable professional skills, and create a real career path for yourself.

**Help people make smart insurance decisions.**

You'll work with new customers to understand what they need and recommend coverage that makes sense for them. You'll have access to 100+ product options across auto, home, renters, life, health, business insurance, and more.

**Sell—and follow up.**

Sales is an important part of this role. You'll work active leads, talk with people who are already shopping for insurance, follow up with prospects, and ask for their business. There are monthly sales expectations, and we'll be upfront about what those are.

**Build relationships, not just quotes.**

We're not interested in winning someone's business solely because we're the cheapest option. We want customers who value having an agency and a team they can actually rely on. Your job is to help create that relationship from the first conversation and advise them on your recommendations.

**Learn an industry.**

You do NOT need to come to us knowing insurance. We'll teach you. What we can't teach as easily is curiosity, work ethic, accountability, and a willingness to learn. **Those are qualities you need to bring with you.**

**Get out into Atlanta.**

We're active in our community. You may join us at festivals, home shows, local events, referral visits, business partnerships, charitable initiatives, and other opportunities to meet the people and businesses around us.

* You're motivated by goals and like seeing the results of your work.
* You aren't afraid to pick up the phone.
* You can stay organized when there are a lot of things happening at once.
* You like people and genuinely enjoy helping them.
* You want feedback and opportunities to get better.
* You're comfortable being held accountable for your results.
* You enjoy being part of a small team where everyone contributes.
* You're looking for more than "just a job" and want somewhere you can grow.

* 1–3+ years of professional work experience
* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
* Excellent phone presence
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and stay organized
* Self-motivated and comfortable working toward measurable goals
* Team-oriented and willing to jump in when needed
* Interested in continued personal and professional development
* Comfortable working in a small-office environment
* Ability to pass a background check
* Property & Casualty and Life & Health licenses—or willingness to obtain them before your start date

Interested in eventually owning a business yourself? Even better. For the right person, this role can be an opportunity to learn how a successful insurance agency operates from the inside and potentially prepare for agency ownership in the future.

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM

**Location:** Atlanta, GA – in office

**Work From Home:** Two days per month after training

**After-hours/Saturdays:** Optional

**Compensation:** Competitive base salary + commission

**Average Total Compensation:** $65,000–$95,000\*

**Benefits include:**

* 10 days PTO to start
* 401(k) with company match
* Life & disability benefits
* Teladoc health service
* $500 signing bonus
* Monthly promos to earn extra money or PTO
* Paid training and professional development
* Performance-based commission opportunities

**A note about compensation:** This is a sales-driven position, so total earnings will depend on individual performance. We believe in being transparent about expectations and earning potential throughout the interview process.

One More Thing

We're not looking for someone who checks every box perfectly.

We're looking for someone who is **dependable, motivated, coachable, good with people, and willing to work hard.** If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our yard is located in **Norcross**, providing a home base for serving these communities.

This is an opportunity to sell comprehensive tree-care solutions-not just tree removal and pruning, but also **Plant Health Care** programs that help clients protect the health and long-term value of their landscapes. You'll partner with another sales arborist serving neighboring Atlanta territories, with company-supported marketing and digital lead generation to help fuel your success.

**The Role**
------------

The Arborist Account Manager is a year-round career focused on consultative sales, territory growth, and long-term client relationships. As the face of the "Joshua Tree Experience," you'll evaluate properties, identify tree and plant health needs, and close premium service agreements.

We're looking for someone who can turn an initial tree-care inquiry into a lasting client relationship by recommending both immediate services and ongoing care.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Territory Growth: Actively prospect, generate referrals, and build new business throughout Norcoss, Peachtree Corners, Sandy Springs, Embry Hills and the surrounding areas. Leverage company-supported marketing campaigns and digital leads while developing your own pipeline.
* Comprehensive Tree-Care Sales: Sell tree removal, pruning, and plant health care services through a consultative, relationship-based approach.
* Plant Health Care Development: Identify opportunities for ongoing plant health care programs, educate clients on recommended services, and build recurring client relationships.
* Property AssessmentsProposals: Conduct thorough site inspections, evaluate client needs, determine accurate job costs, and deliver clear, professional proposals.
* Client Experience: Provide prompt follow-up after services, ensure client satisfaction, and generate repeat business and referrals.
* Operational Partnership: Collaborate with office staff and production crews to communicate job scopes, client expectations, and service requirements.
* Brand Ambassadorship: Model our core values: ***Reliable, Team Player, ImproveAdapt,*** and ***Find A Way***.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 4+ years of proven success in outside sales, B2C sales, or territory management - required.
* Knowledge of plant health care programs and the ability to explain and sell them effectively - required.
* General tree-care knowledge, including tree removal and pruning services.
* ISA Certified Arborist credential - preferred.
* Georgia pesticide applicator's license - preferred.
* Strong prospecting, relationship-building, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Comfort working with computer systems, mobile technology, and digital proposals; CRM experience is a major plus.
* Valid driver's license, clean driving record, and flexibility to accommodate client schedules.

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

This is a commission-driven sales opportunity for someone motivated by performance-based earnings.

Total Annual Earning Potential: 110,000–150,000 through base salary and commissions. Actual earnings depend on individual sales results; this range is not guaranteed

* -but is more than possible!
* Health, dental, and vision insurance with shared-cost options.
* Company-paid short-term disability insurance.
* Six paid holidays and five days of PTO, with PTO increasing each year of service.
* Company-owned sales vehicle for sales calls, with take-home privileges. Personal use is not permitted due to insurance limitations.
* Company-provided cell phone and tablet.
* Ongoing professional development, including company-paid exam fees, license renewals, and continuing education for credentials deemed necessary for the role.

**Why Joshua Tree Experts?**

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Insurance vertical, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. Our insurance risk solutions help drive better data-driven decisions across the insurance policy lifecycle, all while reducing risk. **About Our Team**
------------------

At LexisNexis Risk Solutions, we help insurance organizations make smarter, data-driven decisions throughout the policy lifecycle. Our team supports customers by obtaining and managing critical records and documentation that contribute to accurate risk assessment and operational efficiency. As part of a collaborative, fast-paced production environment, we work closely with internal partners, law enforcement agencies, and other external resources to deliver high-quality results that help our customers reduce risk and improve outcomes. We are committed to accuracy, teamwork, and exceptional service, creating an environment where employees can learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact every day.

  
  

**About the Role**

You will work with internal and external resources, including law enforcement agencies, to help ensure records are accurate, complete, and delivered in accordance with company standards. jobs.description:
**THE SALVATION ARMY**

**NORTH & CENTRAL ILLINOIS DIVISION**

**LAWN CORPS**

POSITION DESCRIPTION

**POSITION TITLE:** Corps Ministries Program Coordinator

**LOCATION/DEPT:** Lawn Corps

**REPORTS TO:** Corps Officers

**FLSA CATEGORY:** Non-Exempt

**STATUS TYPE:** RFT

**PAY GRADE:** 204

**PAY RANGE:** $25.00

**DEPARTMENT MISSION**

To assist in accomplishing the mission of The Salvation Army to save the lost, serve suffering humanity and make disciples for Jesus, by providing leadership to community and Corps programming, developing partnerships with community agencies and contacts, representing the Army at community events, and developing comprehensive expertise and leadership skills in order to build and maintain corps programming. This person will recognize that The Salvation Army is a church and agree that they will do nothing to undermine its religious mission.

**OUTCOMES**

Participates in corps programming**.** Represents the Salvation Army in the community.Facilitates corps officers in planning and implementing corps programs.Develops and supports leadership for corps programming.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Administrative Duties**

* When the Corps Officers are unavailable during business hours, providing overall leadership/direction to staff, volunteers, program participants, etc.
* Report monthly records and statistics of Corps programming to the Corps Officers.
* Collect and record payments for dues/fees for any Corps programs.
* Create and provide informational materials on Corps Seasonal, Special, and Year-round Programming and Events.
* Provide assistance with Corps Seasonal, Special, and Year-round Programming and Events.
* Coordinate with the Corps Officers regarding budget needs for programs.
* Upkeep promotional materials online and bulletin boards to ensure accurate and up-to-date information is communicated on behalf of the Corps.

**Programming Duties**

* Assist the Corps Officers to establish, plan, and implement programming in the corps utilizing Army programs (e.g., Women's Ministry, Character Building, Men's Ministry, Community Care and Bible Study) to include Sunday ministries.
* Collaborates with Corps leadership in initiating and presenting new program proposals.
* Assist the Corps Officers to serve as a resource for all group leaders, providing support and encouragement and ensuring training opportunities.
* Assist the Corps Officers and leaders in scheduling and promoting upcoming events and programs to Corps members and the public through various methods, including social media, posters, marquee signs and personal invitations or other methods as instructed by Corps Officers.
* Upkeep storage spaces utilized for programming to ensure program/event materials are easily accessible and organized.
* Arrange with the Corps Officers and provide leadership for special Corps events and outreach events (e.g., Corps retreat, vacation bible school, fall fest, holiday meals, etc.).
* Serve as the main communicator for program participants parents giving reminders and updates of all youth activities including weeknight and weekend activities.
* Lead Sunday Youth/Junior Church
* Coordinate with Corps Officers & Corps Leaders to gather and prepare supplies and spaces for programming
* Research and propose youth outings/field trips, including the transportation plan, to Corps Officers.

**Seasonal Duties**

* Assist in distributing communication of Christmas Registrations (e.g. Angel Tree, Thanksgiving Food Box, Christmas Food Box, Senior Christmas Party, etc.).
* Assist with Christmas assistance intake for Angel Tree and Food Boxes.
* Assists with communication and coordinating with donors for Angel Tree tag creation, tag disbursement, and donation pick up.
* Assist with Christmas food boxes and Angel Tree preparation and distribution.

**Other Duties**

* All other duties as assigned.

**REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the Corps Officers.

In contacts related to this position's duty, this individual acts as a representative of The Salvation Army and its mission.

**PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS**

This individual will be evaluated on how effectively the outcomes of this position are achieved as evidenced by adult corps programming, youth programming and outreach events. Timeliness and accuracy of accomplishing assigned goals will be reviewed monthly.

A 30, 60, and 90-day performance review will be conducted.

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE**

* High school diploma or GED required; associate degree in ministry, education, nonprofit management, recreation, youth development, human services, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of two years of experience coordinating programs, events, activities, volunteer initiatives, youth programs, ministry programs, community outreach efforts, or related work.
* Valid driver's license and MVR clearance required.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, virtual communication platforms, and social media.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) with the ability to communicate fluently in Spanish required.

**COMPETENCIES**

* Willingness to promote the mission of The Salvation Army.
* Excellent communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills.
* Uses diplomacy and good judgement.
* Demonstrated ability to use initiative and be a self-starter.
* An attention to detail, procedures, processes, and policies.
* A positive attitude and the ability to be flexible considering changing job positions/priorities.
* An ability to manage projects, priorities, and programs in a constantly changing environment.
* A communication and management style that exhibits the principles and values of the Army as well as fosters team relationships and effectively communicates information.

**POSITION LIMITATIONS**

* This individual will only commit Army resources that have been allocated or approved.
* This individual will keep the Corps Officers informed on all critical issues relating to their area of responsibility

**Summary:**  
Equal Hope is a non-profit sitting on the Rush University Medical Center Campus (Sankofa Wellness Village) dedicated to eliminating health inequities, particularly in cancer care. The organization focuses on providing free breast and cervical cancer services to uninsured and underinsured individuals. Through research, advocacy, education, and patient navigation, Equal Hope strives to create sustainable health outcomes and true health equity. Equal Care is a project of Equal Hope. Equal Care believes that inadequate access to quality health care drives many healthcare disparities. To Equal Hope, equal care means providing solutions and improvements that make care accessible to all.

**Other information:**  

* 5+ experience in community health, public health, health education, health promotion, public outreach, and community engaged research
* Bachelors degree or higher in Public Health, Community Health, or a related field
* Ability to understand data, design, implement, and evaluate health promotion programs that address community needs
* Experience in the field of breast or gynecological cancer would be useful though not necessary

  
**Preferred Job Qualifications:**  

* Masters of Public Health
* Experience working in or with hospital systems, academic medical centers, community health centers, or health-focused coalitions.

  
**Physical Demands:**  
N/A
  
  
**Competencies:**  

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent health promotion, public outreach, and community partnership building skills.

  
**Knowledge and Expertise:**  

* Demonstrates contemporary academic, technical, professional knowledge and ability necessary to meet job responsibilities. This can include knowledge of program operation, monitoring, and evaluation. Stays current in the field and is knowledgeable concerning new developments. Invests in efforts to maintain and enhance professional competence and applies knowledge obtained in development of policies/procedures.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, and PowerPoint necessary.
* Experience working with Canva, Kahoot, Slido.

  
**Teamwork:**  

* Demonstrates a willingness to work as part of a team and establish effective working relationships with others throughout the organization and with key external collaborators. Participates in a collaborative/cooperative manner to achieve organizational goals. Seeks opportunities to share information, knowledge and expertise to enhance organizational effectiveness. Willing to travel as needed.
* As a small organization, Equal Hope requires all staff to be willing to collaborate on its large events and to work occasionally at evening or weekend events as part of their employment.

  
**Disclaimer:**  
The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.

**Responsibilities:**  
PROJECT COORDINATION
  

* In collaboration with the Epidemiologist or Director of Health Research, establishes program(s) to support the mission of Equal Hope. Programs may include but are not limited to: Health Ambassadors, Research Roots, Reproductive Roadmap, and other health promotion programs.
* Leads health promotion activities through curriculum development, participant recruitment, education delivery, and program evaluation.
* Keep detailed records of program participants and coordinate schedules of guest speakers or volunteers
* Collect, interpret, and apply quantitative and qualitative data to track program outcomes.
* Responsible for writing up evaluation for Equal Hope projects and has proven success in abstract and manuscript preparation.
* Assists with leading initiatives that support the three pillars of Equal Hope: Equal Access, Equal Care, and Equal Voice.
* Ability to work outside of normal working hours (evenings or weekends)

  
CARE COORDINATION
  

* Conduct outreach for potential clients who are interested in receiving services from Equal Hope (primary care, mammograms, cervical screening, diagnostic exams, treatment)
* Coordinate with Equal Hope Patient Navigators for smooth client hand-offs and continuity of care
* Document all efforts in Equal Hope database, REDCap, or Qualtrics

  
RESEARCH
  

* Coordinates, participates, and assists in a variety of activities involved in the collection, compilation, documentation, and analysis of data related to cancer screening, diagnosis, treatment, and survivorship.
* Assist with external research partners through survey collection, project coordination, evaluation of research results
* Uses data to identify key learning and health promotion focus areas, assists with the development of health promotion programing that is grounded in science, evidence-based, and relatable to diverse audiences.

jobs.title: Digital Content Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

As one of the fastest-growing on-the-go drinkware companies in America, we’ve got a reputation for doing great things. Our vision is simple - bring delight to eating and drinking.

Delight is different to everyone. Whether it’s the perfect cup of coffee, or a water bottle that helps you crush your workout, our mission is to make it look great, function perfectly and cost less than you’d expect.

Delivering on this promise takes extraordinary efforts and exceptional people. Through our teams’ ingenuity and grit, we’ve created a place where the best ideas win, and they can come from anyone. Our culture combines the scrappy spirit of a startup with the perks of a market leader.

We believe the right way to design products starts and ends with two key ingredients: process + people. Process is the path that takes us from ideas to products that are on brand, on time and on budget. People are the secret sauce that adds ingenuity every step of the way.

Together, we navigate each day with optimism, curiosity, a healthy sense of humor and a strong allergy to the word “no.” This desire for better, coupled with a deep understanding of consumers’ daily lives, gets us to meaningful delight.

**About the Role**

Do you love a well-run shoot almost as much as the final shot? Reporting to the Digital Content Producer, the Leapfrog Content Coordinator will keep our photo and video production running smoothly, from writing creative briefs and booking talent to tracking samples and checking every asset for color and detail before it goes out. You’ll work with teams across the company on product launches, seasonal campaigns, and retailer needs, and help grow our network of creative talent along the way. If you’re organized, detail-obsessed, and excited to help bring our brands to life across retail and digital channels, we’d love to meet you!

**What You’ll Do**

* Support production of photo and video content that aligns with brand messaging, marketing plans, and business objectives.
* Draft detailed creative briefs for photo and video shoots, ensuring alignment with brand vision, storytelling objectives, and campaign strategies.
* Maintain a well-organized production schedule for all shoots, tracking deadlines, asset delivery, and project milestones.
* Handle first outreach to photographers, videographers, or other vendors to check availability for upcoming shoots.
* Collaborate with the Sample Coordinator to ensure timely delivery of approved product samples for photo and video shoots.
* Complete first-pass edit reviews for digital assets including color accuracy against the physical sample, retouching notes, file specs, and naming conventions.
* Manage retailer-specific content requests and ensure assets meet partner deadlines and brand compliance standards.
* Work cross-functionally to prioritize production projects based on seasonal marketing campaigns, product launches, and retailer needs.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive list of creative vendors, continuously sourcing new talent to support evolving content needs.
* Ensure all assets are properly named, categorized, and stored for seamless cross-functional access.
* Stay up to date with industry best practices and emerging trends in photography, videography, and digital content.
* Occasional travel to off site shoots when needed.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Visual Communications, Journalism or related field preferred.
* 1+ years of hands-on experience in content production, creative operations, or marketing coordination, ideally in consumer products or retail.
* A sharp eye for visual detail, including color accuracy, image quality, and retouching needs.
* Highly detail-oriented and organized, with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey ideas and collaborate across teams.
* Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and working knowledge of digital asset specs, naming conventions, and file organization; DAM experience is a plus
* Experience in photo and video production, including conceptualizing shoots, coordinating with vendors, and overseeing post-production, is a strong advantage.

**Benefits at Leapfrog**

* 15 days Paid Time Off your first year, and an additional day each year thereafter (up to 25 days), as well as company paid sick days, holidays and parental leave options
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as commuter benefits and additional voluntary benefits
* Annual bonus payouts for all salaried employees, and up to a 5% 401k match with no vesting period
* Summer Fridays - from Memorial Day to Labor Day enjoy half days every Friday

Learn more about life at Leapfrog and our benefits by visiting us at www.leapfrogbrands.com

Leapfrog is currently operating under a hybrid work model, and this position will report on site to our Lincoln Park office at least 2 days per week. Additional ad-hoc in office days may be required based on business needs. Please do not apply if you are not comfortable with a hybrid work model.

$50,000-57,500, full-time, salaried, exempt, hybrid
